title: Alumen
text: This remedy is characterized by a general tendency to hardening and contraction of the tissues. It is useful in cases of constipation and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of dryness and lack of secretions. It is also useful in cases of malignant diseases and tumors. Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Dryness and rawness in the throat. Swollen and hard. Sensation of a splinter in the throat. Appetite poor. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Distended and hard. Flatulence. Chronic constipation. Stool large, hard, and dry. Much straining. Constipation. Haemorrhoids, with burning and itching. Hardening of the uterus. Leucorrhoea. Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of tearing in the larynx. Compare: Alumina; Baryta carbonica; Conium. Third to thirtieth potency.
